final: WITH matched_telescopes AS (SELECT t.telescregistry, t.bandusagepct, o.lunarstage FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation), phase_stats AS (SELECT lunarstage, AVG(CAST(bandusagepct AS FLOAT)) AS avg_bandwidth, COUNT(bandusagepct) AS telescope_count FROM matched_telescopes GROUP BY lunarstage), mean_of_averages AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bandwidth) AS overall_mean FROM phase_stats), kept_phases AS (SELECT ps.lunarstage, ps.avg_bandwidth, ps.telescope_count, moa.overall_mean FROM phase_stats ps CROSS JOIN mean_of_averages moa WHERE ps.avg_bandwidth > moa.overall_mean) SELECT AVG(avg_bandwidth) AS avg_of_kept_averages, SUM(telescope_count) AS total_telescopes_kept, AVG(avg_bandwidth - overall_mean) AS avg_excess FROM kept_phases
